name: High Templar Tech Limited
summary: High Templar Tech Limited operates as a consumer-oriented financial technology service company in the People's Republic of China. The company provides aircraft leasing services; technology development and services; and research and development services. It also offers social security insurance including pension insurance, unemployment insurance, work-related injury insurance, and medical insurance for its employees.
